news.title: Black Opal Consultants’ ₹55 crore IPO to open on September 29
news.para: Black Opal Consultants has fixed a price band of ₹185-197 per share for its IPO, which will open on September 29 and close on October 1. At the upper end, the issue size is about ₹55.08 crore.

news.title: Arbour extends ₹70 crore facility to GSquare Group for Chennai plotted projects
news.para: Arbour has extended a ₹70 crore structured credit facility to GSquare Group to support plotted developments across Chennai’s ECR and Sriperumbudur corridors. The funding includes support for G Square Kings Haven, a 12.47-acre project comprising 235 residential plots.

news.title: NoBroker targets ₹1,250-1,300 crore revenue in FY27, eyes monthly profitability by March
news.para: NoBroker reported revenue of over ₹1,000 crore in FY26, up about 3.6% from ₹965 crore in FY25, while losses declined 25% to ₹290 crore. The company is targeting 25-30% revenue growth in FY27 and expects to achieve monthly profitability by March 2027.

news.title: Australia housing runs out of rescuers as RBA is set to hike rates
news.para: As house prices in Australia decrease, the Reserve Bank of Australia is expected to raise interest rates again. The rise aims to manage ongoing inflation risks stemming from global events and domestic demand. Economists project significant drops in housing prices, suggesting potential economic downturns. Despite falling prices, policymakers are skeptical about the impact on household spending.

news.title: M5 Mahendra Group to invest ₹350 crore in Bengaluru housing project
news.para: M5 Mahendra Group will invest about ₹350 crore to develop Mahendra Solterra in Electronic City, Bengaluru. The 8.4-acre project will comprise 522 homes with an estimated GDV of ₹925 crore.

news.title: Lucknow development body to launch multiple housing projects soon
news.para: The Lucknow Development Authority is gearing up to launch an array of residential initiatives aimed at meeting the varied housing demands across the city. Upcoming projects include Aditi Apartments in Anant Nagar, which will house 1,392 budget-friendly flats in five impressive towers. Aishbagh Square will cater to the upscale market with 384 luxurious 3-BHK flats spread over four towers.

news.title: InvITs, REITs' assets-under-management may double to ₹20 lakh crore by FY31: ICRA
news.para: The combined assets under management of InvITs and REITs are expected to increase to around ₹20 lakh crore by FY31 from approximately ₹10 lakh crore in FY26, according to ICRA. The rating agency expects InvIT AUM to reach ₹13.5 lakh crore and REIT AUM ₹6.5 lakh crore.

news.title: IIFL Home Finance signs $150 million loan pact with JICA for affordable housing
news.para: IIFL Home Finance has signed a $150 million loan agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency to expand housing finance for women from economically weaker sections and low-income groups. The funding will be deployed under a co-financing arrangement involving ADB and private lenders.

news.title: ED widens Mohali real estate probe; serving, former IAS officers under scanner
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate escalates its probe into questionable financial dealings in Mohali's real estate market. Senior GMADA officials are under scrutiny, and searches are underway at the home of Rajiv Gupta, former GMADA Chief Administrator. The ED is dissecting transactions involving various real estate firms, particularly focusing on two auction sites tied to suspect developers. This investigation also intertwines with the ongoing inquiries surrounding the Suntec City project.

news.title: Shriram Properties to surpass doubling profit by FY29, explores mall-led rental income in West Bengal
news.para: With ambitious goals, Shriram Properties Ltd aims to double its net profit and sales bookings by FY29, fueled by a surge in project completions. Having reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 100.81 crore, the company is setting its sights on a realizable income of around Rs 3,000 crore. Its expansive construction pipeline spans about 50 million sq ft through FY29.

news.title: High court appoints warrant officer after Punjab government seeks intervention in ED searches
news.para: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has intervened by appointing a warrant officer to closely watch the operations of the Enforcement Directorate. This directive comes on the heels of a plea from the Punjab government for immediate action amid ongoing inquiries. The Enforcement Directorate has executed searches related to suspected money laundering activities, focusing on the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority.

news.title: Gurugram civic body's new demolition waste disposal rule linked to OCs
news.para: In a bid to enhance construction and demolition waste management, MCG has rolled out new guidelines mandating that developers and government bodies adhere to improved waste disposal practices. Larger projects must submit a detailed waste management plan via the MCG portal for approval, while accurate documentation of waste deposits will be essential for completion certificates.

news.title: Drive against illegal constructions moves beyond residential colonies in Gurugram
news.para: In response to rising concerns over illegal construction, the Haryana State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation is set to conduct a plot-wise survey targeting industrial zones like Udyog Vihar phases I-VI. Three dedicated joint inspection teams will execute the evaluations and provide consistent progress updates. This initiative aims to thoroughly document any land use and construction violations amidst increased scrutiny in the region.

news.title: Gurugram civic body seeks transfer of ₹690 crore purchasable FAR revenue from HSVP
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Gurugram has made a formal request for the transfer of nearly Rs 690 crore, collected through purchasable floor area ratios, currently held by Haryana Shahari Vikas Pradhikaran. With increased urban development pressing against existing civic infrastructure, MCG commissioner Pradeep Dahiya is urgently seeking detailed financial records from HSVP to determine how much funding can be allocated to various sectors in Gurgaon.

news.title: Maharashtra: Proposed housing bylaws draw 5,000-plus objections and suggestions
news.para: A significant wave of engagement has led the state cooperation department to receive more than 750 emails regarding the 2026 model bylaws, which encompass an impressive array of over 5,000 objections and recommendations from housing societies and community members. Amidst crucial discussions, topics of concern feature parking arrangements, society billing, and committee powers.

news.title: Shriram Properties to pump in ₹4,000 crore more into Uttarpara project
news.para: Shriram Properties plans a massive investment of Rs 4,000 crore in its Uttarpara project, diversifying into residential, commercial, healthcare, and educational facilities. Having already invested Rs 2,000 crore, they've developed 65 acres, with ongoing projects including 3,400 flats in phase two and 198 villas in phase three. The company's CMD envisions a transformation that will turn Uttarpara into a thriving hub akin to Bengaluru's Whitefield.

news.title: Runwal Enterprises targets 2:1 debt-equity ratio after IPO: Chairman
news.para: Runwal Enterprises is gearing up for a significant Rs 500-crore initial public offering set to debut on September 25. The funds raised will facilitate debt repayment and support new project acquisitions. With a current debt-to-equity ratio of 3:1, the company aims to trim this down to 2:1. Furthermore, it plans to transition to an asset-light model and focus on expansion in the western suburbs over the next few years.
